name: Cryosleep
primary:
The sci-fi cryo pod. The creature you aim at (or you, if you aim at nothing) is sealed in a block of ice for 3 s.
• Ally or you: can't move, resistance V, heal 1 ❤ every 0.5 s — up to 6 ❤
• Foe: frozen for 3 s, then chilled for 3 s more
self_description: You seal yourself in ice: 3 s without moving, resistance V and up to 6 ❤ of healing.
